facts.fact: The Boletim Oficial of 19 February 2019 carries the text of Lei n.º 48/IX/2019, which sets the principles, norms and structure of the National Statistical System (SEN); the law is dated 19 February 2019, the document's published date.

Cabo Verde's INE board says it asserts its technical independence under the Lei de Bases do Sistema Estatistico Nacional (SEN), which the article treats as the law in force; the law's own date is not given, so the article's publication date is used.

facts.fact: The CNEST president says a report on the application of the 2019 national statistical system law is due to the National Assembly by December 2025, treating that law as existing.

facts.fact: INE Portugal's COOPSTAT n.º 25 says its mission supported revision of the current Law of the National Statistical System of Cabo Verde, which establishes how the system functions.
